title: Traya’s FY26 Revenue Jumps 73% YoY To ₹585 Cr, Loss Up 23%
summary: Haircare brand Traya’s top line zoomed significantly in the fiscal year FY26, crossing the ₹500 Cr threshold. The Fireside-backed startup’s…
llm_summary: Traya, the Fireside‑backed hair‑care startup, posted a dramatic revenue surge in FY 26, climbing 73% year‑over‑year to ₹585 crore and finally breaking the ₹500 crore mark. However, the rapid growth came at a cost: the company’s net loss widened by 23% compared with the previous fiscal year, highlighting the trade‑off between scaling fast and achieving profitability.
